title: Backend Engineer (Go)
text:
About Lumen Grid
Lumen Grid forecasts demand for utilities moving to renewables. We are a small, remote-first engineering team that ships every day and keeps on-call quiet.
The role
As a Backend Engineer (Go) you will own services end to end: design reviews, the code, the dashboards and the pager. You will work closely with product and with the other engineers on the team.
What you will need
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with PostgreSQL
- 4+ years of hands-on experience with Go
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with Distributed Systems
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with gRPC
- several years of hands-on experience with GraphQL
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Terraform
- Clear written communication; we decide things in documents
Nice to have
- Exposure to OpenTelemetry
- Exposure to CI/CD
- Exposure to Prometheus
Benefits
Competitive salary and equity, a learning budget, and four weeks of vacation that people actually take.
